newsitem.title: USA: Paramount Financial oks stock buyback plan.
newsitem.headline: Paramount Financial oks stock buyback plan.

text.p: Paramount Financial Corp said Tuesday it approved the repurchase of up to $500,000 worth of the company's common stock not currently held by management.
The repurchase program is effective immediately and is authorized to continue for a period of two years, the company said in a statement.
The plan will allow the company to repurchase shares at any time during the authorized period and in any increment as it deems appropriate, the company said.
The purchases will be financed through available cash or funds generated from operations, and the stock will be purchased on the open market or privately.
The company said it has 7,990,000 shares outstanding of which 3,200,000 are held by management.
Paramount Financial Corp is an information technology asset management and solution provider offering customers integrated services, including lease finance, network design and implementation.
